ques: Find the standard Personal Allowance amount for Income Tax in the current tax year.
judge_rubric: Must open the Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances guidance page and report the standard Personal Allowance figure shown there. An answer with no figure, or not drawn from that page, is a FAIL.

ques: Find out the full weekly amount of the new State Pension.
judge_rubric: Must open The new State Pension guidance page and report the full weekly amount stated there. Missing amount = FAIL.

ques: What is the deadline for filing an online Self Assessment tax return?
judge_rubric: Must open a Self Assessment guidance page and state the online filing deadline (a specific date). Missing date = FAIL.

ques: Find the standard rate of VAT that applies to most goods and services.
judge_rubric: Must open the VAT rates guidance page and state the standard VAT rate (a percentage). Missing rate = FAIL.

ques: How many qualifying years on your National Insurance record do you usually need to get the full new State Pension?
judge_rubric: Must open The new State Pension guidance page and report the number of qualifying years needed for the FULL new State Pension (not the minimum for any pension). Missing or incorrect count = FAIL.

ques: Find out the penalty for filing your Self Assessment tax return one day late.
judge_rubric: Must open the Self Assessment deadlines guidance page and state the penalty amount for filing one day late. Missing amount = FAIL.

ques: Navigate to the guidance page explaining what you pay Capital Gains Tax on, and its rates and allowances.
judge_rubric: Must navigate to the Capital Gains Tax 'what you pay it on, rates and allowances' guidance page; the answer must show the agent reached that specific page. FAIL if it was never opened.

ques: Find the name of the minister responsible for HM Revenue & Customs.
judge_rubric: Must open the HM Revenue & Customs organisation page and name the responsible minister as listed there. A name not drawn from that page = FAIL.

ques: Find out how many people the Department for Work and Pensions employs.
judge_rubric: Must open the Department for Work and Pensions organisation page and report the employee headcount shown there. Missing number = FAIL.

ques: Go to the HM Treasury organisation page and find the year it was established.
judge_rubric: Must open the HM Treasury organisation page and report the year of establishment shown there. Missing year = FAIL.

ques: Find the most recently published announcement on GOV.UK and summarise what it is about.
judge_rubric: Must open the announcements listing (or homepage announcements feed), identify the single most recently published announcement, and summarise it. Naming the wrong story or giving no summary = FAIL.

ques: Find the HMRC news story that reports how many Self Assessment returns were filed on time, and state the figure.
judge_rubric: Must open the announcements listing (or the HMRC organisation page), identify the HMRC Self Assessment news story, and state the number of returns filed on time. Missing figure = FAIL.

ques: Use the search to find the guidance on applying for or renewing an adult passport, and identify which organisation is responsible for it.
judge_rubric: Must open the adult passport guidance page and name the organisation responsible for it. Missing or incorrect organisation = FAIL.

ques: Find how to apply for or renew a Blue Badge for disabled people.
judge_rubric: Must open the Blue Badge guidance page and describe how to apply for or renew one (for example online or via the local council). FAIL if the page was not opened.

ques: Find the guidance page for the Skilled Worker visa and identify which department publishes it.
judge_rubric: Must open the Skilled Worker visa guidance page and name the department that publishes it. Missing or incorrect department = FAIL.

ques: Find the service used to book your driving test.
judge_rubric: Must open the 'Book your driving test' service page and identify it as the service for booking the practical driving test. FAIL if the page was not opened.

ques: Find out how to register to vote in the UK.
judge_rubric: Must open the Register to vote page and explain how to register. FAIL if the page was not opened.

ques: Find the foreign travel advice guidance and name the organisation that provides it.
judge_rubric: Must open the Foreign travel advice guidance page and name the organisation that provides it. Missing or incorrect organisation = FAIL.

ques: Browse the Childcare and parenting topic and find the guidance on Child Benefit eligibility.
judge_rubric: Must reach the Child Benefit eligibility guidance (ideally by browsing the Childcare and parenting topic) and describe who is eligible. FAIL if the page was not opened.

ques: Find the NHS England news story about the NHS App and state how many users it has reached.
judge_rubric: Must open the announcements listing (or the NHS England organisation page), identify the NHS App news story, and state the number of users reached. Missing figure = FAIL.
